name: bleep-checkout
description: Monorepo do Bleep Checkout: apps/api (NestJS) e apps/web (Angular). Só scripts de orquestração; cada app tem o seu package.json.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test -- --watch=false
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
